subject: Draft onboarding roadmap + sample evaluation slate
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Garza <agarza@streamline.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 22 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Draft onboarding roadmap + sample evaluation slate

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. Per our conversation I put together a lightweight onboarding roadmap and a short evaluation slate to make it easy for your team to validate latency, throughput, and acceptance criteria during a pilot. Attached are the two seed assets: a doc (editable) and a slides wireframe for the kickoff.

High-level asks:
- Please confirm the primary stakeholders (name + role + best contact) to include in the MAP stakeholder table.
- Confirm preferred pilot length (30/45/60 days) — we can shift the milestones.
- Share any compliance items we should include in the tech-checklist (e.g., IP, data residency).

Quick notes on the assets:
- SOO_MAP_Template_v1.gdoc — MAP skeleton (roles, milestones, acceptance metrics).
- MAP_Slides_wireframe.pptx — kickoff slide deck (30/45/60 timeline variants are on slide 3).

Link: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1a2b3cSOO_MAP_Template_v1 (edit access granted to agarza@streamline.ai)
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/deal/DEAL-2027-1187

If you prefer, we can run a 30-minute workshop early next week to co-edit the doc. Would Monday or Tuesday morning PT work?

Best,

--
Soojin Lee
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0192

Attachments: SOO_MAP_Template_v1.gdoc (Google Doc link), MAP_Slides_wireframe.pptx (pptx attachment)
From: Alex Garza <agarza@streamline.ai>

Subject: Re: Draft onboarding roadmap + sample evaluation slate

Thanks Soojin — this looks promising. Quick answers from our side:
- Primary stakeholders: Diego Ramos (VP Engineering), Laura Chen (CISO), and myself. I added Procurement (procurement@streamline.ai) since they’ll need the pricing stub.
- Pilot length: we’re leaning toward a 45-day technical pilot to validate throughput at our peak QPS. Can you update the cadence to 45 days and include weekly performance checkpoints?
- Compliance: Laura will send a short list (SOC 2 questions + encryption at rest) — please loop her in.

Can Marissa/Ben include a short note in the MAP about the dedicated capacity option and a high-level cost range so Procurement can start internal approvals?

Happy to do a co-edit session next Tue 8:30am PT if that works for your team.

Thanks,
Alex

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>

Date: Thu, 22 Jul 2027 13:20:05 -0700
Subject: Re: Draft onboarding roadmap + sample evaluation slate

Alex — thanks for the quick feedback. I made the following edits in the live doc (link below):
- Updated the timeline to a 45-day pilot and added weekly performance checkpoints (Week 1 validation, Week 3 throughput baseline, Week 5 scale test, Week 7 acceptance review).
- Populated the stakeholders table with Diego Ramos (VP Eng), Laura Chen (CISO), Alex Garza (Head of AI).
- Added a technical checklist entry for SOC 2 and encryption at rest; flagged Laura to review items.
- Inserted a small dedicated-capacity option box under the deployment section — Ben will add cost ranges.

Proposed next steps:
1) Ben to add a high-level pricing slide + one-pager for Procurement.
2) Co-edit workshop: Tue 27 Jul, 8:30am PT (30 mins) — I can run the doc walk and collect acceptance metrics.
3) After co-edit, we’ll lock milestones and ship a pilot statement of work (SOW) draft for legal/procurement.

Link to updated MAP: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1b2c3dStreamline_MAP_v1 (Marissa — edit access)

Ben — can you confirm if dedicated capacity at our standard trial discount fits Streamline’s expected QPS targets? If not, we’ll propose a short burst test + autoscale allowance.

Thanks,
Marissa

--
Marissa Cole
Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0234

Subject: Re: Draft onboarding roadmap + sample evaluation slate

Hi Alex / Procurement team —

Attached is a concise pricing stub for the 45-day pilot (Streamline_Pilot_PRICING.pdf). Highlights:
- Dedicated trial option: estimated cost range $6k–$9k for the 45-day window based on expected peak QPS and sequence length assumptions.
- Hosted burst model (no reserved capacity): estimated token spend $1.5k–$3.5k depending on test volume; recommended for smaller initial throughput tests.
- Optional add-on: extended logging retention + audit bundle for compliance (+$1k).

Next steps to move forward quickly:
1) Procurement: confirm preferred billing entity and PO cadence.
2) Legal: if Procurement needs an SOW/temporary addendum, we can share a pilot SOW template within 48 hours after milestone lock.
3) Tech kickoff: schedule 45-minute runbook and staging checklist session week-of pilot start.

I’ll upload the pricing stub to the MAP doc and add a one-slide cost summary to the kickoff deck. Let me know if you want a containing deck for internal approvals.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0278
